name: smwsprites-display-message
title: Display Message 1
description:
Sprite 19 in SMW, disassembled. It's the display message from message box one sprite.

If the extra bit is set it will display the level's second message.
If the extension field in lunar magic is set to a non-0 value it'll read from that level.
Note that you need to subtract #$DC for levels above 24 to get the correct value.

To be assembled with PIXI.
